*Auto-generated by `ml/scripts/eval_cnn.py`. Bootstrap n=1000, seed=42.*

Architecture (V2): 3x Conv1D (96, 192, 192 channels) + BatchNorm + ReLU + Dropout(0.4); global max pool; FC(192->96) + BN + FC(96->1). One-hot, MAX_LEN=100, 21 channels.

Checkpoint: epoch 48, val AUC 0.8445.
